description: This script is a Node.js utility for testing extensions related to a project, utilizing 'pnpm' and 'vitest'. It handles command-line arguments to run tests for a specified extension or path, manages process spawning, and interacts with project-specific functions like 'resolveExtensionTestPlan'.

methods.name: runVitestBatch
methods.description: Asynchronously spawns a child process to run Vitest tests with provided parameters, managing process exit and error handling.

methods.name: printNoTestsMessage
methods.description: Logs a message indicating no tests were found for the specified extension folder.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main async function coordinating argument parsing, plan resolution, and test execution.
